content: Whose name opens the long family lists of 1 Chronicles?
explanation: The lists start at the very beginning. “Adam, Seth, Enosh” (1 Chronicles 1:1, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, what did Jabez ask God to enlarge?
explanation: God granted his request. “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory!” (1 Chronicles 4:10, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, how did God answer the prayer of Jabez?
explanation: Jabez called on the God of Israel. “And God granted the request of Jabez.” (1 Chronicles 4:10, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, why should we give thanks to the LORD?
explanation: His love endures forever. “Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” (1 Chronicles 16:34, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, what did King David tell Solomon before building the temple?
explanation: God would not fail him. “Be strong and courageous, and do it.” (1 Chronicles 28:20, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, whom did David have the Levites appoint to praise with joy?
explanation: With harps, lyres, and cymbals. “David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers” (1 Chronicles 15:16, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, why did Jabez's mother give him his name?
explanation: Yet he was honorable. “His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”” (1 Chronicles 4:9, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, what was Jerusalem's earlier name?
explanation: The Jebusites lived there. “Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus)” (1 Chronicles 11:4, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, why did God not let David build the temple?
explanation: He had waged great wars. “You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.” (1 Chronicles 22:8, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, what kind of man would Solomon be, according to God?
explanation: Israel would have peace in his reign. “But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest.” (1 Chronicles 22:9, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, why did David make lavish preparations for the temple?
explanation: The temple had to be magnificent. “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent” (1 Chronicles 22:5, BSB)

content: In David's prayer in 1 Chronicles, to whom does everything in heaven and earth belong?
explanation: His is the kingdom. “for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You.” (1 Chronicles 29:11, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, where did David say the people's generous gifts came from?
explanation: Everything comes from God. “For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.” (1 Chronicles 29:14, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, why did Saul die?
options: He was unfaithful to the LORD
explanation: He even consulted a medium. “So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD” (1 Chronicles 10:13, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, how is King David described at his death?
options: Full of years, riches, and honor
explanation: Solomon reigned after him. “He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor” (1 Chronicles 29:28, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, what did Satan incite David to do?
explanation: It displeased God. “Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.” (1 Chronicles 21:1, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, to which prophet did David say the ark was under a tent?
explanation: David lived in a cedar house. “he said to Nathan the prophet, “Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent.”” (1 Chronicles 17:1, BSB)

content: In 1 Chronicles, who is listed right after Adam?
explanation: The list continues with Enosh. “Adam, Seth, Enosh” (1 Chronicles 1:1, BSB)
